It would be great if anyone could help confirm this error, which I so far have only seen on my Macbook M4 Pro. Is it just on my laptop or can others confirm it, too? Problem illustration : Black areas appear on film strip, as shown on http://oslobalanse.com/Problemdescription.mp4 and on http://oslobalanse.com/ProblemOnUserProfile.mp4 Exact Environment Details : MacBook Pro, 14", November 2024. 24GB, macOS is Tahoe 26.6.2 Expected results : A kind of film strip behaviour is expected. The images should glide or pan with constant speed across screen from right to left. Images should halt until fully overlapped on left or right screen edge depending on width of image (if larger or smaller than actual window size). The loop should be continuous. Actual results (so far only confirmed on Apple M4 Pro) : The only visible error is the appearance of huge black spaces after ~18 secs, when the images disappear. The speed of movement is also no longer constant. This bad behaviour has so far only been confirmed on Apple M4 Pro. Troubleshooting Steps Taken : Step1: I have tried and confirmed the error both on version 26.3 and 26.6. The error has also been confirmed on both Safari and in Chrome. I have disabled hardware acceleration on Chrome, but it did not help. Step2: I have tried on a second user profile on the M4 Pro, and the web page image rendering worked fine there, hence confirming the problem can be isolated to a User Profile.
